text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle said she was making 
okonomiyaki at home today, so I ended up 
tagging along to buy ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there you are! I've been waitin' for 
ya~!
choice_data_list: Tamamo Cross is coming along too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I thought we'd have leftover 
ingredients, so I invited them over. And 
then, they even offered to help with the 
grocery shopping~

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! It goes against my nature to just 
be fed for free! Well then, let's get 
going!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
First, the eggs! You've gotta have 
brown-shelled eggs for okonomiyaki, 
right~?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Why? The white one would've been fine. 
The nutritional value is the same, ya 
know?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That might be true, but! Using fancier 
eggs makes you feel like you're eating 
luxurious okonomiyaki, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's the inside that gets used so the 
shell color shouldn't matter, I reckon, 
but... well, I kinda get where they're 
comin' from.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Now then, shall we head to the shopping 
district next?
choice_data_list: Can't we just buy it here?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You just don't get it~. You can't make 
delicious okonomiyaki like that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Okonomiyaki is all about ingredient 
teamwork! The better the ingredients you 
gather, the more delicious it gets!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Cabbage, cabbage~. Umm, umm............"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's got bug bites on it! This is the 
one! I'll take this, please!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
My mom told me: "Vegetables with bugs on 
them are so delicious that even bugs can't 
resist eating them!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
“Still, havin' too much of it eaten ain't 
good either. 'Cause that'd be a waste. 
Just a tiny bite taken out is the sweet 
spot!”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, smells so good! Tempura scraps from a 
deep-fry shop really are the best!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you put tempura scraps in it? I only 
ever use them for takoyaki, so I can't 
wait to see how it tastes!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The texture is great! Plus, because it's 
made with oil used for frying various 
things, it gives it a deep, rich flavor~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Next is the main course, right? Hmm, so if 
it's pork belly...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, let's go with seafood this time. We 
can enjoy all sorts of things like shrimp 
and squid, and doesn't it just feel so 
luxurious?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Seafood!? Well, ain't that fancy!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... But gathering all of them would be 
really tough, so...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking of going with the frozen 
seafood mix~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You're NOT gonna be picky about that?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, if we're gonna do it, might as well 
get the best deal and try a bunch of 
different things, right?!

After finishing our shopping, we headed 
back. Hishi Miracle's passion for 
okonomiyaki was truly something to behold.
choice_data_list:
You're really particular about your 
okonomiyaki, huh!

You're really particular about your 
okonomiyaki, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Of course, because I love it! When you 
love something, you can't help being 
particular about it, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You really didn't compromise on your 
principles today, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, because I have my own idea of the 
ultimate okonomiyaki! And that's something 
I won't compromise on!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well... I was definitely a little more 
fired up than usual, though.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“I'd be so happy if everyone comes to love 
my special flavor~”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So today, we're making homemade 
okonomiyaki. That way, I can be super 
particular about the ingredients to match 
my tastes...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...So with that in mind, Trainer. You'll 
have some of my okonomiyaki... right?

After returning to the academy, we made 
and ate okonomiyaki together. True to 
Hishi Miracle's particular tastes, it was 
incredibly delicious!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: That was so good~~~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Phew~! Using tempura flakes is a great 
idea, too! Maybe I'll try that at my place 
next time~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! So, how was it? How was 
my okonomiyaki?
choice_data_list: I'd love to eat that again!

With this, maybe I don't even need to eat 
out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Whenever you feel like eating, just 
let me kno—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, let's make sure we only eat it on 
special occasions after all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I feel like doing it that way feels more 
special and makes it taste even better~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I know, right~?! Then we'll have to set 
aside a special day for next time!

I'm looking forward to the next day I get 
to eat her okonomiyaki.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's not true at all. Physical shops 
have their own wonderful qualities...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The batter is fluffier than when I make it 
at home, and the ingredients are chopped 
to perfection. Above all else—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to do any prep or cleanup, 
okay?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yer right. Welp, shall we start the main 
event of an at-home okonomiyaki party... 
cleanin' up?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, this right here is the biggest 
downside of working from home...

With Hishi Miracle looking thoroughly 
exhausted after saying that, we cleaned up 
the place together.
